paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah.
Yoma 85a mentions Rabbi Yishmael and Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah walking along the road, with Levi HaSadar and Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah, walking
behind them. The same appears at the beginning of the Mekhilta’s Ki Tisa section. Hyman suggests he may be Rabbi Yishmael ben Elazar of the preceding entry.

notes.text: The heading spells out Elazar ben Azaryah, which is the expansion of רא״בע here, not Rabbi Akiva. The complete Yoma 85a paragraph also includes Akiva in the first group; the supplied notice abbreviates that group. The identification with the preceding entry remains Hyman’s suggestion.
